sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.content:
AI video generation has crossed a critical threshold from experimental technology to mainstream cultural phenomenon. Viral clips from Seedance—featuring deepfake fights between Brad Pitt and Tom Cruise—are flooding social media feeds, while Kanye West's Instagram debut of an AI-generated music video signals Hollywood's embrace of the technology. Google Photos' new "Me Meme" feature democratizes AI creativity for consumers, enabling anyone to insert themselves into trending memes with a few taps.

Simultaneously, AI is accelerating its transition to commercial infrastructure. OpenAI has officially begun monetizing ChatGPT through advertising, marking a watershed moment in the productization of generative AI. The advertising industry is responding with structural changes: new protocols for agentic AI integration are emerging while publishers grapple with AI's existential threat to ad-supported business models. This dual reality—AI as both opportunity and disruption—is driving massive economic shifts, exemplified by Taiwan's revised 7.7% growth forecast powered by AI chip demand.

The convergence of viral consumer adoption, enterprise monetization, and agentic workflow integration suggests we're entering a new phase where AI moves from novelty to necessity across creative, commercial, and economic domains.

sections.heading: Key Trends
sections.content:
• **AI Video Goes Viral:** Seedance tool generates celebrity deepfake content trending across social platforms; Kanye West debuts AI video in new music release

• **Monetization Milestone:** OpenAI launches advertising in ChatGPT, signaling shift from experimental to revenue-generating AI products

• **Agentic AI in Ad Tech:** New Ad Context Protocol enables AI agents to autonomously manage advertising workflows; The Trade Desk expands agentic capabilities

• **AI-Driven Economic Growth:** Taiwan forecasts 7.7% GDP growth on AI chip demand; ByteDance developing proprietary AI chips in talks with Samsung

• **Consumer AI Creativity:** Google Photos launches "Me Meme" feature allowing users to recreate trending memes with personal photos

sections.heading: Notable Articles
sections.content:
**Taiwan Hikes 2026 Economic Growth Forecast to 7.7% on AI Demand**
[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/)
Taiwan's government raised its economic growth projection to 7.7%, driven by surging global demand for AI chips and semiconductor manufacturing. The revision underscores AI's macroeconomic impact beyond software.

**ByteDance Developing AI Chip in Manufacturing Talks with Samsung**
[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/)
ByteDance is reportedly developing proprietary AI chips and negotiating with Samsung for manufacturing, joining tech giants like Google and Amazon in custom silicon development to reduce dependence on Nvidia.

**Seedance AI Video Tool Goes Viral with Brad Pitt vs Tom Cruise Clips**
[BBC News](https://www.bbc.com/news/topics/ce1qrvleleqt)
Clips of deepfake celebrity fights generated by new AI video tool Seedance are spreading rapidly across social media, demonstrating AI video generation's breakthrough into mainstream consumer culture.

**South Korea's Open-Source AI Surge on Hugging Face**
[Hugging Face via X](https://x.com/ClementDelangue/status/2008954270411051465)
South Korea now has three trending models on Hugging Face thanks to state support for open-source AI development, highlighting how government investment is diversifying the global AI landscape beyond US-China competition.

sections.heading: What's Trending on X
sections.content:
**Kanye's AI Video Debut Signals Hollywood Shift**
[@rowancheung](https://x.com/rowancheung/status/1750038245826867629): "Kanye West posted a preview of his new song on IG today, featuring an AI-generated video. AI has been trending hot in Hollywood lately. The next few months are going to be wild for AI video."

**Google Photos' "Me Meme" Feature**
[@DigitalTrends](https://x.com/DigitalTrends/status/2015088345337176391): Google Photos rolls out AI-powered "Me Meme" that lets users recreate trending memes with their own photos, bringing generative AI to casual social media users.

**Konnex: Intelligence as On-Chain Commodity**
[@ngthu279339](https://x.com/ngthu279339/status/2011319060169187778): Discussion of Konnex network treating AI intelligence as a "first-class commodity" that can be owned, versioned, and stored on-chain, reflecting growing interest in decentralized AI infrastructure.

**South Korea's Open-Source AI Strategy**
[@ClementDelangue](https://x.com/ClementDelangue/status/2008954270411051465): Hugging Face CEO highlights South Korea's three trending models as proof that state support for open-source AI enables countries beyond US/China to compete in AI development.
